name: check-gcp-logger
description: Local desktop app for browsing GCP Cloud Functions logs with per-function multi-select and detail expansion.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.docker:rebuild: docker compose build --no-cache check-gcp-logger && docker compose up -d --force-recreate
